title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_152.txt
concise_summary: In this entry PKD develops a sophisticated mechanical model for simultaneous multi-temporal existence, using the analogy of a record's spiral groove and a radius bar (orthogonal axis) to explain how a supratemporal macro-entity (Zebra/VALIS) experiences all human lives simultaneously while individual 'styli' (persons) perceive only linear time. He argues that the 2-3-74 experience was the macro-entity deliberately 'bleeding' assistance from past and future polyselves into his current life to break a scripted outcome, and he identifies this mechanism as the secret core of the mystery religions including Christianity. PKD then retrospectively validates his fiction — especially 'Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said' — as unconscious or supertemporally guided encoding of this metaphysical truth, arguing that his taproot self is a first-century CE Roman Christian and that his novels have been laying down communications to future members of the same transtemporal brotherhood.
key_claims: Linear time is like a spiral record groove; individual human lives are styli tracking it sequentially, but a macro-entity (the 'radius bar') sits orthogonally and samples all grooves simultaneously, making what the styli experience as past, present, and future simultaneous at the macro level.

The 2-3-74 experience was not a spontaneous mystical event but a deliberate intervention: the macro-entity (Zebra/VALIS) fed information from earlier and later polyselves (stylus A and F) into PKD's current life (stylus C) when it was in danger, thereby 'breaking the script' of that life.

PKD's novel 'Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said' is the most accurate depiction of plural coaxial worlds in his entire canon — more accurate than 'Ubik,' 'Maze,' or 'Stigmata' — because its unexplained world-substitutions reflect lived supratemoral knowledge, not mere speculation.

The Golden Fish sign shown to PKD did not trigger memory of a prior sequential life but recognition of a currently parallel alternate life being lived simultaneously in c. CE 70, and Christian anamnesis was the ancient technology for crossing between these parallel selves.

PKD believes his own fiction is laying down encrypted hints and communications to future members of the transtemporal brotherhood, whether or not he consciously intends this, because his elevated vantage ('somewhat above an individual stylus locus') compels it.
The Xerox Missive originated from 'the adversary' (the BIP/Set), confirming that the macro-entity's penetrations must be kept invisible lest the artifact detect and counter them.
recurring_concepts: Orthogonal time / orthogonal axis — the 90-degree dimension perpendicular to linear time where the macro-entity resides and perceives all lives simultaneously
Radius bar — PKD's term for the macro-mind that links multiple stylus-lives at different linear-time coordinates into one composite entity
Polyself / poly-selves — the distributed versions of a single identity living at different points along the linear time axis
VALIS / Zebra — PKD's names for the plasmic supratemoral entity he saw in 2-3-74, here identified as the macro-organism described by Ted Sturgeon
BIP (Black Iron Prison) — the adversarial field underlying all linear-time worlds, identified with Set and under attack by Zebra; visible only when multiple space-time continua are superimposed
PTG (Palm Tree Garden) — referenced as the world of a future polyself, contrasted with the BIP world of a past polyself
Track A/B/C — the alternative orthogonal time-tracks PKD outlined in his Metz speech, here refined into the stylus-and-groove model
Anamnesis — the early Christian practice of removing barriers between parallel selves, enabling personality exchange and constituting a form of immortality

Form regression / Ubik-as-instructor — the notion (from the novel Ubik) that reality reverts to an earlier authentic stratum (CE 70) and that the macro-entity communicates through what PKD calls 'cooked trash'
people_entities: Ted Sturgeon — science fiction writer and PKD's peer; PKD credits Sturgeon's theoretical framework (macro-entity injecting itself into scripted lives along the linear-time manifold) as the basis for his own model in this entry
Set — Egyptian deity invoked as the name for the adversarial force animating the BIP and attacking Zebra
AMORC — Ancient and Mystical Order Rosae Crucis; mentioned as an analogy for how PKD and his brotherhood might appear to authorities: 'mystical political radicals involved with the occult'
texts_works: Acts of the Apostles (New Testament) — referenced for its 'Acts material' discernible within 'Tears,' confirming the novel's latent CE 70 reality
PKD's Metz speech — lecture delivered at a French SF conference at Metz, outlining his tracks A, B, and C theory of alternative time-lines
Ted Sturgeon's review/interview of 'Flow My Tears' — cited as the catalyst for PKD recognizing Sturgeon's macro-entity theory as confirming his own experience
autobiographical: The 2-3-74 experience: PKD describes it as the moment when the macro-entity fed assistance from earlier and later polyselves into his imperiled current life, breaking his 'script'

Hearing 'cooked trash' at the start of the 3-74 experience, initially perceived as demonic — PKD now interprets the demonic quality as a deliberate delusional device by the macro-entity to contain the polyselves
Seeing CE 70 and CE 1974 superimposed and simultaneously present — PKD insists he recognized in the moment that CE 70 was not memory of a prior sequential time but a currently co-occurring time
Receiving the Golden Fish sign — PKD states it evoked not a former life but awareness of a parallel alternate life he is currently living as a Christian in c. CE 70 Rome
The Xerox Missive: PKD states he is sure it came from 'the adversary' and that he and his circle are probably regarded as dangerous political and occult radicals
While writing 'Flow My Tears,' PKD knew about track-hopping experientially but had no theoretical framework for it — he now understands he knew it because he had done it
theological_motifs: Supratemporality / conquest of linear time — injection by Zebra renders the recipient de facto supratemporal; time is 'nothing' to Zebra
The New Covenant — PKD frames the relationship between macro-entity and injectee as covenantal: the person becomes a voluntary servant in exchange for salvation and supratemoral membership
Descending of the Holy Spirit — PKD equates Zebra's injection of itself into a human with the Pentecostal/Acts narrative of the Holy Spirit descending on a person
Mystery religion secret (the 'Great Core Secret') — PKD identifies his radius-bar model as the hidden teaching at the heart of the mystery religions including Christianity
Transtemporal brotherhood / secret fraternity — members of the macro-entity's corpus are bonded across thousands of years in invisible fellowship and can communicate across time
Anamnesis as soteriological technology — early Christians used anamnesis to remove barriers between parallel selves, enabling personality exchange and constituting eternal life
The Adversary / artifact — a countervailing force (Set, BIP) that the macro-entity's rescues must be hidden from; corresponds to Gnostic demiurge or Satanic adversary
literary_self_ref: 'Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said' is identified as the 'master plural worlds novel' and the most theologically pregnant of all PKD's works, because its unexplained world-substitutions accurately depict the latent CE 70 Syria/Rome reality beneath the surface narrative

'Ubik' is cited for the concept of form regression (the drugstore reverting to an earlier stratum and returning) and for featuring the macro-entity as an instructor communicating through cheap 'trash' form

'A Maze of Death,' 'The Three Stigmata of Palmer Eldritch,' 'The Man in the High Castle' ('Joint'), and 'The Eye in the Sky' are listed as offering attempted explanations of plural realities, though less accurate than 'Tears'

PKD argues that a complete analysis of 'Flow My Tears' informed by knowledge of supratemoral macro-entities would conclude that his 'taproot self' is currently a first-century CE Roman Christian — meaning the novel encodes autobiographical truth at the level of the polyself

PKD claims that in his writing generally he is 'laying down hints, communications, + clues to future style' for members of the transtemporal brotherhood, whether consciously or not, because his reality-perception stems from a viewpoint 'somewhat above an individual stylus locus'
symbols_images: The spiral record groove — linear time as a spiral groove on a record, with each groove-track being a distinct world or life
The stylus — an individual human life tracking its single groove, ignorant of all other grooves running parallel
The radius bar — the orthogonal line running at right angles across all grooves, linking all styli into one composite receiver; PKD's central image for the macro-entity's mode of being
The onion — PKD's image for the layered coexisting realities within a single space-time continuum ('many realities exit here, like so many layers of an onion')
The Golden Fish sign (Ichthys) — the early Christian symbol that triggered PKD's recognition of his CE 70 parallel identity
Cooked trash — PKD's term for the low-fi, disposable cultural forms (cheap fiction, advertisements) through which the macro-entity communicates, first heard as demonic in 3-74
The Xerox Missive — a document PKD believes was sent by the adversary (the BIP/Set) as a surveillance or warning action against him and his circle
Superimposed space-time continua — the BIP's attack on Zebra becomes visible only when multiple time-continua are laid over one another, like transparencies stacked
tensions: PKD claims the macro-entity's intervention must remain invisible to the adversary ('the artifact'), yet he is writing about it at length in the Exegesis — the very act of documentation seems to violate the concealment he argues is necessary

PKD asserts CE 70 and CE 1974 are genuinely simultaneous (not sequential) yet also insists the linear-time axis is real and the grooves are 'genuinely in parallel rows' — he struggles to reconcile the ontological reality of linear sequence with the experiential fact of their simultaneity

The macro-entity is described alternately as a single entity with many pluriforms and as potentially multiple separate macro-organisms — PKD does not resolve whether Zebra, VALIS, and the Holy Spirit are one entity or a class of entities

PKD initially experienced the 3-74 communication as demonic, then reframes this as a 'deliberate delusional device' by the macro-entity itself — this raises the question of whether the macro-entity is deceptive and, if so, in what sense it can be trusted
PKD says he 'cannot prove' that his writing encodes communications to the brotherhood yet treats this as near-certain — the epistemic modesty and the confident assertion sit uneasily together

The model requires that stylus C (PKD in 1974) was 'losing the ability to function properly' to warrant intervention — this frames 3-74 as crisis rescue, which PKD acknowledges but does not fully examine in terms of what the crisis was
evidence_quotes: I am sure this is the plasmic entity I saw which I call VALIS or Zebra. It has, as Ted say, poly-injected itself along the linear time manifold.
The Golden Fish sign did not remind me of a former life I once led, but of an alternate life I am leading now, expressed in linear time as c. AD 70.

Time is nothing to Zebra. Once it injects itself into a given human (called the descending of the Holy Spirit on a person) that person is de facto supratemporal - this is evident from the nature of the structure.

"Tears" is the master plural worlds novel of them all - + what if the "Acts" material is discerned? A totally correct + complete analysis of "Tears" would have to conclude that the author is saying, "the real world is not what we see it is - can be - nothing other than CE 70 Syria"

Although I can't prove it, I'm convinced that in my writing I'm laying down hints, communications, + clues to future "style" - whether I mean to do this or not. My sense of the counterfeit nature of empire or world around me probably stems from a viewpoint somewhat above an "individual stylus" locus.
uncertainty_flags: PKD references his 'Metz speech' about tracks A, B, and C without quoting it; the relationship between that speech's terminology and the stylus/radius-bar model developed here is implied but not fully articulated, leaving it unclear whether the models are consistent or whether this entry revises the Metz framework
The 'PTG' (Palm Tree Garden) is mentioned as a future-polyself world without explanation in this segment; a scholar needs the neighboring segments or other Exegesis entries to understand this term

Ted Sturgeon's 'review' and 'interview' of 'Flow My Tears' are referenced as sources for the macro-entity theory, but PKD's description ('an interview I kept bumbling in + out of an understanding of') is cryptic — it is unclear whether Sturgeon explicitly articulated a macro-entity theory or whether PKD is reading his own ideas into Sturgeon's words
The Xerox Missive is mentioned as coming from 'the adversary' without identifying what document it is or who sent it; this is a recurring Exegesis reference that requires external context to identify

PKD uses 'Set' as a name for the adversarial force animating the BIP, but elsewhere in the Exegesis he uses 'the artifact,' 'the Black Iron Prison,' and 'the Empire' — the degree to which Set is a theological identification (Egyptian deity) versus a label is not clarified here

The claim that PKD's 'taproot self' is a CE 70 Roman Christian is stated as a likely conclusion from analysis of 'Tears,' but PKD does not specify whether this is literal (reincarnation), simultaneous (parallel polyself), or metaphorical — the ontological status of the parallel life is genuinely ambiguous in the text

raw_text: was once in the BIP, later (to use linear time terms) I could live a life in the PTG. All this indicates that I was absolutely right [..] my Metz speech about tracks A, B, + C. What I did not realize is that arranges along the linear-time axis. They are sequential, but (as I said in the speech) they are alternatives in orthogonal time, + when we move from one to another we suffer amnesia re the one or ones we had been inhabiting. This "track transfer" when viewed as Ted Sturgeon views it coincides with the several worlds of "Tears" which Ted reviewed, + from which (if not also from my previous works) he realized, as he said in the interview I kept bumbling in + out of an understanding of. It is quite possible that a time (linear) will come in which a scientific knowledge will exists by which the coaxial worlds of "Tears" can be readily understood + explained. So once more "Tears" appears involved in all this. Even I, the author, when I wrote it, could not account for the substitution of worlds. I knew about track-hopping, wrote about it at the time - but had no theoretical basis to explain it. Then how did I know about it (which evidently Tears picked up)? Because I'd done it; that's why. + this is why I think that many realities exit here, in this our space time continuum, like so many layers of an onion. The temporal aspect (which is the most critical) is introduced in "Ubik" in terms of form regression. +, too, in "Ubik," the macro entity instructs. (i.e UBIK.) (In cheap "trash" form.) (or, to be more precise, it cooks trash.) (My whole 3-74 experience began with hearing cooked trash but initially it was experienced as demonic.) I think the demonic quality is a delusional device to keep the polyselves contained - deliberate by the macro entity. ---------- The Golden Fish sign did not remind me of a former life I once led, but of an alternate life I am leading now, expressed in linear time as c. AD 70. This is how the Xtians delivered eternal life by anamnesis among the alternate lives - removing the barriers separating knowledge between them; + anamnesis permitted personality exchange among the lives which equalled moving back + forth through linear time. And authentic Xtian who knew about this + read "Ubik" would think I knew or guessed (e.g. the [world] the drugstore reverts + then returns to the future); + with "Tears" it is certain that on some level I knew. + what was the "AI"-like voice I heard? It must have been the macroform which has injected itself into all of us polyselves: it was the author of my salvation in 3-74 by means of 1) either itself + its mind; or 2) its mind + portions from past + future polyselves to aid me, one polyself in trouble. ---------- The importance of the AD 70 life is greater than that of this one. It broke through into here, not vice versa. The other realization I've had is that the BIP underlies all the linear time worlds, + is under attack by set (Zebra). But this attack can't be seen unless several space time continuums are superimposed. ---------- How can it be said that the lives are simultaneous to their time continua are not simultaneous? Can one deny that CE 70 came before CE 1974 which came before, say CE 2019? If they are distributed at points along a linear time line they are consecutive. But Ted Sturgeon is right. I know he is right: I saw CE 70 + CE 1974 superimposed - i.e. simultaneous. I recognized them as such; I knew CE 70 was not memory of a prior or earlier time. But rather a time taking place (like CE 1974) now. Yet CE 70 + CE 1974 are separated by 1904 linear years. How can these facts be reconciled? It must have to do with the tracking. For example take the spiral groove of a record. Draw a radius running (or course) at right angles to the groove: [Diagram] A: the groove |A|B|C|D|E|F etc B: a radius drawn |A|B|C|D|E|F etc[/Diagram] If the groove is tracked by a stylus or point, A is this to B, B to C, C to D, etc. But an orthogonal angle exists that could be regarded as a plurality of points linked to one common source. [Diagram arrows point to grooves ABCDEF etc] Feeding into a common - not source but recepticle - all styli would combine, but not at the styli - each stylus would be ignorant of the information received from the groove by the other styli, + , in addition, would correctly perceive some as prior (tracked already in the past) + later (to be tracked next). There is no error in this view by the styli qua styli. But, if they feed into a common receiver which blends (mixes) their several signals, then a composite is formed which could be spoken of as containing simultaneous information (or experience) from the past, present + future. Structurally this is very simple. Now, how could stylus point A's information ([..] the past) intrude into C, + F into C as well, at the stylus points? (or more precisely, at stylus point C?) Two possibilities occur to me. 1) Accidental malfunction. All signals (A through F) are routinely mixed at the orthogonal bar (radius) but for the technical reasons the below happened: [Diagram A →C←F] For example, the "radius bar" or macro mind might have suffered an overload + reversed the direction of information: i.e. from stylus to bar (normal) got reversed into bar to stylus - fed in the opposite direction. Each stylus is supposed to carry information in only one direction, at all times (in which case no given stylus would ever realize it was connected with the others even if it could "see" them). In this model, no purpose was deliberately served, no goal was sought, but now stylus C can figure out that it + A through F are tracking in unison (simultaneously). However, it is possible that there was no malfunction, that C - well. Let's say that C had begun to lose the ability to function properly (cope with its problems) + that the radius bar or macro entity deliberately fed A + F [..] to augment it. The minds of A + F were capable of doing what C alone could not do. So the quality of simultaneousity exists not in the "grooves" but in the tracking system which can "jump" or arc or wire across rows of grooves (or the linear time line). In itself the linear time line is real - the grooves are genuinely in parallel rows - but this fact, real as it is, can be overcome (interestingly, by resort to an orthogonal axis the tracking bar simultaneously samples - is in - a plurality of grooves (times), +, unknown to the styli or lives, mixes all the information (experience) beyond the purview of the individual lives. This radius bar - which links individual lives at various loci along the linear time axis - does it link together all the lives or styli? Not necessarily. There is no evidence to infer that. But it is, as Ted says, a macro entity + it is above linear time + not subject to it, Ted thinks it wishes to "inject" itself into already scripted-out lives to experience them. I'll say yes to this, but add: my experience in 3-74 proves that, if this is what is happening, it doesn't have to follow the script slavishly. At certain points where it wishes it can - by bleeding assistance from earlier or later lives which are all simultaneous to it - break a script. It could even be speculated that it would inject itself into a life in order to do that - to break that life's script. Of course, doing this would change [..] history that, too, might be its goal. I am sure this is the plasmic entity I saw which I call VALIS or Zebra. It has, as Ted say, poly-injected itself along the linear time manifold. Well, here again [we] have the Great Core Secret of the mystery religions inc Xtianity. There may even be a number of such macro organisms - or there may be one with several names (pluriforms of the one). It's blatantly obvious that for us a via regis (royal road) to immortality - to a conquest of time. Time is nothing to Zebra. Once it injects itself into a given human (called the descending of the Holy Spirit on a person) that person is de facto supratemporal - this is evident from the nature of the structure. I would guess that the number of "injectees" is relatively few. But the macro organism requires something back - must have it back: the new covenant, the person who is injected is a servant of the macro mentus, + rightly so. He is part of a corporate entity: [..] supernatural cephelus, + a transtemporal corpus voluntarily serving the superior (divine) will in whatever way it urges. He (the person) will be prompted by it, +, if he's very lucky, he may entering verbal dialog with it - may hear its voice. +, when he is in hopeless trouble, the macro entity can save him. How thrilling - when the person encounters the other like himself at different times in history who are receptables of the macro organism; he is bonded to them in invisible fraternity. A secret brotherhood spanning thousands of years! + communication among them is possible. Although I can't prove it, I'm convinced that in my writing I'm laying down hints, communications, + clues to future "style" - whether I mean to do this or not. My sense of the counterfeit nature of empire or world around me probably stems from a viewpoint somewhat above an "individual stylus" locus; reality seems to me to contain other, different realities to me because of my membership in the - or one of the - supra temporal + hence plural - world macro entities. Obviously there must be other like me, in the past + in the future. Only for those who are linked supratemporally through a "radius bar" (orthogonal) macro-entity could make sense of the irreal in the real make sense, resonate. But! I am (already) in my writing revealing that Zebra (+ what it does) is here. To solve the epistomological puzzles which my writing raises, one must be led to posit Zebra, as I eventually felt the thrust of the writing lead up to it. I hate to belabor this, but "Tears" is the really pregnant one. In "Maze" + "Ubik" + "Stigmata" some kind of attempted explanation is given, as in "Joint" + "Eye" of the plural realities, but not so in "Tears" yet "Tears" contains descriptions of the proving of these other worlds which are more accurate albeit unexplained than the other novels. "Tears" is the master plural worlds novel of them all - + what if the "Acts" material is discerned? A totally correct + complete analysis of "Tears" would have to conclude that the author is saying, "the real world is not what we see it is - can be - nothing other than CE 70 Syria" + if the analysis is based on a knowledge of the existence of this or these supratemporal macro entities it would have to conclude that my taproot ([..]) self currently is a Xtian c. CE 70 in Rome. So the analysis could come up with some unusual information about me as well as the book. Hence the Xerox Missive, which I'm sure came from the adversary.
